newsitem.title: UK: Eurobond trade ideas-Dollar, lire and yen switches.
newsitem.headline: Eurobond trade ideas-Dollar, lire and yen switches.

text.p: Eurobond analysts' latest trade recommendations focused on dollars, lire and yen.
Following are latest trade ideas, compiled by Reuters:

STRATEGY The Ford bond is an under-par liquid issue with a strong corporate franchise trading cheaper than other "A' credits in the same maturity sector. The moves out of the AA names which are trading tight to Treasuries give yield pick-ups which easily beat the credit curve between AA and A names.
STRATEGY BNG is a retail favourite and generally trades well through the curve.

Landwirtschaft Rentenbank has a policy of remaining competitively neutral against other German Banks and is therefore unlikely to be involved in any anti-competition dispute with the EEC which may affect the Landesbanks.
It is also cheap against other German bank names in the two- four year sector.

STRATEGY The trade offers a yield pick-up of 7 b.p. beating the curve by 6 b.p. The trading relation between these two bonds has traditionally been flat. The trade also offers the added bonus of a 10 point cash takeout.
STRATEGY This switch offers a good pick-up in yield of around 19 b.p. without having to lengthen duration too much.
STRATEGY This switch allows investors to pick up liquidity and yield without noticeably increasing duration.
Offering about a 33 b.p pick-up DSL is cheap at around 4 b.p. b.p. through the swap.
STRATEGY This move offers around a 20 b.p. pick-up in yield and shortens duration by over a year.
STRATEGY There is little expectation of any major change in the shape of the euroyen curve over the coming week, so this trade represents an anomoly with a yield give-up of 34 b.p.
